newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia says Boeing deal worth A$500 mln.
newsitem.headline: Australia says Boeing deal worth A$500 mln.

text.p: The project awarded to Boeing Australia Ltd, a unit of U.S. aerospace giant Boeing Co, to upgrade Australia's military shortwave radio system was valued at A$500 million, the defence department said.
"The project is valued at A$500 million, but the contract details are yet to be negotiated," a defence department spokesman told Reuters.
Defence Minister Ian McLachlan said earlier on Thursday that the system, which would be operational early next century, would provide long range communications through four new ground stations.
The stations would be controlled by a network management operation at a site yet to be determined.

"The system will represent a substantial increase in capability over the existing system, allowing nine currently used communications facilities to be closed down with associated savings in personnel and operating costs," McLachlan said in a statement.
